summary: Fixed critical bug in LeadOutreachSection.js where 'calculateSimilarity' was accessed before initialization. Verified fuzzy duplicate detection is working in both Lead Outreach and Lead Inbound sections. Create lead dialog shows 'Potential duplicate detected!' warning with similarity percentage (90%) when entering similar names.

Lead Outreach section loads without erro.description: Fixed JavaScript initialization error: 'Cannot access calculateSimilarity before initialization'. Moved normalizeForComparison and calculateSimilarity functions before checkForDuplicates.

Duplicate detection shows similar names.description: Fuzzy matching algorithm correctly detects similar names with 70%+ similarity. Example: 'Public Form Lead 2' detected as 90% similar to 'Public Form Lead'.

Duplicate warning banner shows count of.description: Yellow warning banner shows 'Potential duplicates detected' when duplicates exist. In Lead Inbound section, 6 yellow warning icons visible for similar entries.

Create lead dialog shows duplicate warni.description: When entering 'Creatividad Pro Test', dialog shows 'Potential duplicate detected!' with 'Similar to: Creatividad Pro (90%)' and 'Review'/'Create anyway' buttons.

Lead Inbound section also has fuzzy dupl.description: Inbound section shows duplicate warning banner and yellow warning icons on rows with similar names. Tooltip shows 'Similar to X (90%)'.

bug_fixed.root_cause: JavaScript hoisting issue - checkForDuplicates useCallback (line 267) referenced calculateSimilarity which was defined later (line 606) in the same component
bug_fixed.fix: Moved normalizeForComparison and calculateSimilarity function definitions before checkForDuplicates to ensure proper initialization order

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix applied: Moved normalizeForComparison and calculateSimilarity hooks to line ~265 (before checkForDuplicates)
Removed duplicate definitions of these functions that were at lines 589-636
Fuzzy matching uses 70% similarity threshold which works well for detecting variations like 'Public Form Lead 2' vs 'Public Form Lead'
The algorithm normalizes names by removing accents, company suffixes (S.A., S.R.L., etc.), and special characters before comparison
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed critical JS initialization bug in LeadOutreachSection.js. Fuzzy duplicate detection is now working correctly in both Outreach and Inbound sections. The create dialog shows duplicate warnings with similarity percentages. Test data doesn't include '1A Eventos'/'1A Events' pairs mentioned in requirements, but the fuzzy matching algorithm is working correctly with existing data like 'Public Form Lead'/'Public Form Lead 2'.
